style.backgroundSystem: seamless lilac-tinted studio white #F7F6FC for packshots, graduated lavender field #A9A2E6 for benefit, comparison and lifestyle frames, warm cream board #F2E4D2 for formula and pain-point flat lays, all on low matte pedestals #EFEAF8

style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium body-care visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of lilac-tinted studio white #F7F6FC, graduated lavender field #A9A2E6, warm cream board #F2E4D2 and one magenta accent #E0218A; neutral bright soft beauty lighting with a front-left key at 5500K, a fill card, shadowless bottle glow and gentle grounding contact shadows; seamless lilac-tinted paper, matte cream board and low matte pedestals #EFEAF8 as the only background surfaces; single modern geometric sans-serif family with rounded pill label chips and thin single-weight line icons in plain circular outlines; the product keeps its exact locked identity from the reference while every spec, badge and list slot stays a blank proof placeholder; stable straight-on to slight 3/4 product scale and centering; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no reshaped or restyled bottle silhouette or label artwork
no invented numbers, seals or credentials inside proof slots
style.presentationRules: 产品自带的品牌字标与其标志性蛋形椭圆轮廓、瓶盖造型与标签排版属产品身份，一律交由 {product_identity_lock} 原样锁定并保留，本模版不描述瓶身造型细节、不复现任何字标或香型名；模版只固定机位、占比、光位、背景与留白结构；所有参数位、印章位、清单位一律以空白 proof placeholder 呈现，标签文字保持清晰不变、不重绘。
